Bee keeping.

Bees are in danger of becoming endangered worldwide and numbers are plummeting. I'm not an expert, but from what I understand, a lot of this is due to pesticides in most farms which weren't even originally supposed to kill bees, but it just so happens that they do. Ironically, this is also the same case for herbicides and clover - a plant that bees love - but that's a whole other post. It's also partly due to parasites killing off hives. We need bees to pollinate our crops. We need bees in order to maintain some semblance of plant life worldwide. Bees are huge.

I just wish that I had the space to build an apiary. I'd love getting honey out of it and there are tons of flowers and clover all around me that the bees would thrive in. I'd encourage anyone who normally raises a fruit, flower, or vegetable garden in the summer to look at starting a hive. It will only help your local plant life.
